title: Cell culture, transfection, immunocytochemistry, and imaging

source_steps.summary: Seed the representative RPE1 imaging well and incubate the cells in complete medium.
Prepare and apply the Lipofectamine/plasmid transfection mixture, then culture the transfected cells.
boundary_notes: Transfection is represented as declared material exposure rather than predicted biological effect.

source_steps.summary: Aspirate the culture medium while retaining adherent cells, add serum-free medium, and serum-starve the cells.
Fix the cells with paraformaldehyde and wash the retained adherent cells three times with PBS.
boundary_notes: Fixation is represented operationally rather than as a complete biological state transition.

source_steps.summary: Permeabilize, quench, and block the fixed cells while retaining the adherent material state.
boundary_notes: Chemical cell-state changes are represented operationally.

source_steps.summary: Incubate with primary antibody and wash the retained cells three times with PBS.
boundary_notes: Antibody specificity and binding are not predicted.

source_steps.summary: Incubate with Alexa Fluor secondary antibody and wash the retained cells three times with PBS.
boundary_notes: Antibody specificity and binding are not predicted.

source_steps.summary: Stain nuclei with DAPI, wash, mount the chamber, and acquire a structured confocal image.
boundary_notes: Microscope settings and image interpretation remain readout metadata or downstream analysis.

semantic_boundaries.label: Cell biology state
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Cell confluency, transfection state, fixation state, and staining specificity are represented operationally rather than as complete biological state transitions.

semantic_boundaries.label: Microscopy acquisition
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Confocal hardware settings and deconvolution are retained as readout/schema metadata rather than executed instrument semantics.
